text_block_list.text:
At last, it's time for Nice Nature's
Debut Race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... A debut, huh?
What a wonderfully fresh ring to it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I bet by tomorrow I'll already be saying,
'Ah, those were the days~.'"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~.
Looking like I have it together is kind of my specialty.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, the real deal starts after making our debut.
...What matters is whether we can fight there or not."
choice_data_list: Get out there and unleash everything you've got!
Go out there and give it your all with everything you've got right now!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "That's true~. If I actually had talent, I'd certainly love to show it off, but..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“Still, stumbling at a crucial moment like this
is honestly pretty typical of me, if you think about it.”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, somehow or other, we'll make it work!
Shall we get going, then~?
